question: In which bodily locations should the practitioner meditate on this moon?
premises: The practitioner should meditate on this moon
The navel and head are specified locations
The heart is also specified as a location
inference: The moon should be meditated upon in the navel, head, and heart.
plain_english: O goddess, one should meditate on this moon as present in the navel, in the head, and in the heart.
